records.literal_gloss: Deceitful [is] the heart above all, and incurable [is] it; who can know it?

en.L: Deceitful [is] the heart above all [things], and incurable [is] it; \q who can know it?
en.B: The heart is more devious than anything else, and it is past healing; \q who can understand it?
en.R: The human heart is more deceitful than anything else, and it is too sick to be cured. \q Who can really know what is in it?

es.L: Engañoso [es] el corazón más que todo, e incurable [es]; \q ¿quién lo conocerá?
es.B: El corazón es más tortuoso que cualquier otra cosa, y no tiene remedio; \q ¿quién puede entenderlo?
es.R: El corazón humano es más engañoso que cualquier otra cosa, y está demasiado enfermo para sanar. \q ¿Quién puede saber de verdad lo que hay en él?

fr.L: Le cœur est trompeur plus que tout, et incurable ; \q qui peut le connaître ?
fr.B: Le cœur est plus tortueux que tout, et il est malade sans remède ; \q qui peut le comprendre ?
fr.R: Le cœur humain est plus trompeur que tout le reste, et il est trop malade pour guérir. \q Qui peut vraiment savoir ce qu’il y a dedans ?

sw.L: Moyo ni mdanganyifu kuliko [vitu] vyote, nao hauponyeki; \q ni nani awezaye kuujua?
sw.B: Moyo una hila kuliko kitu kingine chochote, nao hauwezi kuponywa; \q ni nani awezaye kuuelewa?
sw.R: Moyo wa mwanadamu ni mdanganyifu kuliko kitu kingine chochote, nao ni mgonjwa mno kiasi kwamba hauwezi kuponywa. \q Ni nani anayeweza kujua kweli yaliyomo ndani yake?

vi.L: Lòng [người] là dối trá hơn mọi [vật], và không thể chữa được; \q ai có thể biết được?
vi.B: Lòng người quanh co hơn mọi thứ, và không thể chữa lành; \q ai có thể hiểu thấu được?
vi.R: Lòng con người dối trá hơn mọi thứ, và bệnh nặng đến nỗi không chữa được. \q Ai có thể thật sự biết được điều gì ở trong đó?

ko.L: 마음은 무엇보다 거짓되고 고칠 수 없다. \q 누가 그것을 알 수 있겠느냐?
ko.B: 사람의 마음은 그 무엇보다 교활하고 고칠 길이 없다. \q 누가 그 마음을 알 수 있겠느냐?
ko.R: 사람의 마음은 그 무엇보다 속이기를 잘하고 너무 병들어서 고칠 수 없다. \q 누가 그 속에 무엇이 있는지 정말로 알 수 있겠느냐?

pt.L: Traiçoeiro [é] o coração acima de tudo, e incurável [é] ele; \q quem pode conhecê-lo?
pt.B: Nada é tão tortuoso quanto o coração, e ele não tem cura; \q quem consegue entendê-lo?
pt.R: Nada engana tanto quanto o coração humano, e ele está doente demais para ser curado. \q Quem pode saber de verdade o que há dentro dele?

decisions.choice: deceitful: crooked, tricky; a play on the name Jacob
decisions.reason: The adjective ('aqov) comes from the same root as the name Jacob (ya'aqov), the brother who tricked Esau (Genesis 27:36). In 9:3 the same root is used for every brother who "cheats like Jacob". The word can also mean uneven or hilly ground (Isaiah 40:4), something that twists rather than running straight. The heart, which should be set right by God's teaching, is the most crooked thing of all.

decisions.choice: the heart: the inner person, where thinking, choosing and desire take place
decisions.reason: In Hebrew the heart is the center of thought and will as well as feeling (verse 1; 4:14; 5:23). The saying is about the human heart in general, not only one person's.

decisions.choice: incurable: sick beyond healing
decisions.reason: The word ('anush) is used of a wound or pain that will not heal (15:18; 30:12, 15; Micah 1:9). The same word returns in verse 16 for "the day of disaster", and Jeremiah's prayer in verse 14 asks God for the healing the heart cannot give itself.

decisions.choice: Deceitful / devious / deceitful
decisions.reason: Balanced uses "devious", a word for a mind that takes crooked paths, which keeps the picture of twisting behind the Hebrew word (m1).

decisions.choice: The human heart / Who can really know what is in it?
decisions.reason: Readable says whose heart is meant and that knowing it means seeing what is inside.

decisions.choice: "engañoso" (L, R); "tortuoso" (B)
decisions.reason: The word ('aqov) plays on the name Jacob, as in 9:3; Spanish cannot keep the sound, and each level follows the English.

decisions.choice: Traiçoeiro (L); tortuoso (B); engana (R); incurável, não tem cura, doente demais para ser curado
decisions.reason: The verse is one of the best known in Portuguese, in wording this translation does not copy; each level is drafted from the Hebrew. 'Aqov is the word behind Jacob's name, the one who took crooked ways (m1): Literal says "traiçoeiro", Balanced "tortuoso", which keeps the picture of a crooked path, as the English Balanced says "devious". 'Anush is a wound that will not heal (m3), the word verse 16 uses again.

source.text: אֲנִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה חֹקֵ֥ר לֵ֖ב בֹּחֵ֣ן כְּלָי֑וֹת וְלָתֵ֤ת לְאִישׁ֙ כִּדְרָכָ֔יו כִּפְרִ֖י מַעֲלָלָֽיו׃ס

records.literal_gloss: I, Yahweh, [am] searching [the] heart, testing [the] kidneys, and to give to each according to his ways, according to [the] fruit of his deeds.

en.L: I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, search the heart, I test the kidneys, \q to give to each according to {{gender:their|his}} ways, \q according to the fruit of {{gender:their|his}} deeds.
en.B: I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, search the heart and test the inner feelings, \q to give each person what {{gender:their|his}} ways deserve, \q what the fruit of {{gender:their|his}} deeds has earned.
en.R: But I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, look deep into people's hearts and test their thoughts and feelings. \q I give each person what they deserve for the way they live and for what they do.

es.L: Yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, escudriño el corazón, pruebo los riñones, \q para dar a cada uno según sus caminos, \q según el fruto de sus obras.
es.B: Yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, escudriño el corazón y pruebo los sentimientos más íntimos, \q para dar a cada persona lo que merecen sus caminos, \q lo que se ha ganado el fruto de sus obras.
es.R: Pero yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, miro hasta lo más profundo del corazón de las personas y pongo a prueba sus pensamientos y sentimientos. \q Le doy a cada uno lo que merece por su manera de vivir y por lo que hace.

fr.L: Moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je sonde le cœur, j’éprouve les reins, \q pour rendre à chacun selon ses voies, \q selon le fruit de ses actions.
fr.B: Moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je sonde le cœur et j’éprouve les sentiments, \q pour donner à chacun ce que mérite sa conduite, \q ce que valent ses actions.
fr.R: Mais moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je regarde au fond du cœur des gens et j’éprouve leurs pensées et leurs sentiments. \q Je donne à chacun ce qu’il mérite pour la façon dont il vit et pour ce qu’il fait.

sw.L: Mimi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninauchunguza moyo, ninazijaribu figo, \q kumpa kila mtu kulingana na njia zake, \q kulingana na matunda ya matendo yake.
sw.B: Mimi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninauchunguza moyo na kuyajaribu mawazo ya ndani, \q ili kumpa kila mtu kile ambacho njia zake zinastahili, \q kile ambacho matunda ya matendo yake yamekipata.
sw.R: Lakini mimi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninaangalia ndani kabisa ya mioyo ya watu na kuyajaribu mawazo na hisia zao. \q Ninampa kila mtu kile anachostahili kwa jinsi anavyoishi na kwa yale anayoyatenda.

vi.L: Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, dò xét lòng, thử nghiệm tâm can, \q để báo trả cho mỗi người tùy theo đường lối mình, \q tùy theo bông trái của việc làm mình.
vi.B: Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, dò xét lòng và thử nghiệm tâm can, \q để báo trả mỗi người xứng với đường lối mình, \q xứng với kết quả việc làm mình.
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nhìn thấu tận đáy lòng người ta và thử nghiệm những suy nghĩ và cảm xúc của họ. \q Ta ban cho mỗi người điều xứng đáng với cách họ sống và những việc họ làm.

ko.L: 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 마음을 살피고 콩팥을 시험하여, \q 각 사람에게 그의 길대로, \q 그의 행위의 열매대로 갚는다.
ko.B: 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 마음을 살피고 속생각을 시험하여, \q 각 사람에게 그가 걸어온 길에 따라, \q 그가 한 일의 열매에 따라 갚아 준다.
ko.R: 그러나 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 사람의 마음속 깊은 곳을 살피고 그 생각과 느낌을 시험한다. \q 나는 각 사람이 사는 방식과 하는 일에 따라 마땅한 대로 갚아 준다.

pt.L: Eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, sondo o coração, provo os rins, \q para dar a cada um segundo os seus caminhos, \q segundo o fruto das suas ações.
pt.B: Eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, sondo o coração e examino os sentimentos mais íntimos, \q para dar a cada um o que os seus caminhos merecem, \q o que o fruto das suas ações conquistou.
pt.R: Mas eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, olho bem no fundo do coração das pessoas e examino os seus pensamentos e sentimentos. \q Eu dou a cada um o que merece pelo modo como vive e pelo que faz.

decisions.choice: I, the LORD: God answers the question of verse 9
decisions.reason: The question "who can know it?" is answered at once: the LORD can. He searches what no human can see. Jeremiah calls on this in 11:20, 12:3 and 20:12, and the same truth is stated in 1 Samuel 16:7 and Psalm 7:10.

decisions.choice: the heart ... the kidneys: the whole inner life, thoughts and feelings alike
decisions.reason: The kidneys were thought of as the seat of the deepest emotions and desires, and they are paired with the heart, the seat of thought and will, to mean the whole hidden self (11:20; 20:12; Psalm 7:10).

decisions.choice: according to his ways, according to the fruit of his deeds: what each person's conduct deserves
decisions.reason: "Ways" is the course of a life; "the fruit of his deeds" is what those deeds lead to, picking up the tree that bears fruit in verse 8. The same words return in 32:19. The written consonants have "his way", singular; the scribes marked "his ways" to be read. The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: kidneys / the inner feelings / their thoughts and feelings
decisions.reason: As in 11:20: Literal keeps the body word, and Balanced and Readable give its sense (m2).

decisions.choice: their, with "his" as the alternative
decisions.reason: "Each" means every person, man or woman.

decisions.choice: "sus caminos", "sus obras", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "su", "cada uno" and "cada persona" serve for men and women alike, so the English gender setting has no Spanish counterpart here or in verse 11.

decisions.choice: 나 주가 (no honorific)
decisions.reason: God names himself in the first person, so Korean uses 나 with the plain subject particle, as the terms note sets (나 주가).

decisions.choice: cada um ... os seus caminhos, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English puts "their/his" under the gender setting (r-en-2). Portuguese "cada um" and "seus" already mean anyone, man or woman, so there is no second wording to choose; the same holds in verse 11, where "quem" and the "ele" that refers back to it are ordinary generic Portuguese.

source.text: קֹרֵ֤א דָגַר֙ וְלֹ֣א יָלָ֔ד עֹ֥שֶׂה עֹ֖שֶׁר וְלֹ֣א בְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט בַּחֲצִ֤י יָמָיו֙ יַעַזְבֶ֔נּוּ וּבְאַחֲרִית֖וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה נָבָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: [A] partridge gathers [eggs] and not it has laid, making wealth and not with justice; in [the] half of his days it will leave him, and in his end he will be [a] fool.

en.L: [Like] a partridge that hatches what it did not lay, \q [so is] one who makes wealth, but not with justice; \q in the middle of {{gender:their|his}} days it will leave {{gender:them|him}}, \q and at {{gender:their|his}} end {{gender:they|he}} will be a fool.
en.B: Like a partridge that sits on eggs it never laid \q is the one who gets rich by unjust means; \q halfway through life the riches will leave {{gender:them|him}}, \q and in the end {{gender:they|he}} will be shown a fool.
en.R: A person who gets rich by cheating \q is like a bird sitting on eggs that it did not lay. \q Before their life is half over, their riches will be gone, \q and in the end everyone will see what a fool they were.

es.L: [Como] la perdiz que empolla lo que no puso, \q [así es] el que hace riquezas, pero no con justicia; \q en la mitad de sus días las dejará, \q y en su final será un necio.
es.B: Como la perdiz que empolla huevos que no puso \q es el que se enriquece por medios injustos; \q a mitad de su vida lo abandonarán las riquezas, \q y al final se verá que era un necio.
es.R: Una persona que se hace rica engañando \q es como un pájaro que empolla huevos que no puso. \q Antes de llegar a la mitad de su vida, sus riquezas habrán desaparecido, \q y al final todos verán lo necia que era.

fr.L: [Comme] une perdrix qui couve ce qu’elle n’a pas pondu, \q [ainsi est] celui qui acquiert des richesses, mais pas avec justice ; \q au milieu de ses jours, elles le quitteront, \q et à sa fin, il sera un insensé.
fr.B: Comme la perdrix qui couve des œufs qu’elle n’a pas pondus, \q ainsi est celui qui s’enrichit injustement ; \q au milieu de sa vie, ses richesses le quitteront, \q et à la fin, il se montrera insensé.
fr.R: Celui qui s’enrichit en trichant \q ressemble à un oiseau qui couve des œufs qu’il n’a pas pondus. \q Avant la moitié de sa vie, ses richesses auront disparu, \q et à la fin, tout le monde verra qu’il était fou.

sw.L: [Kama] kwale anayeatamia [mayai] ambayo hakuyataga, \q [ndivyo alivyo] mtu anayepata mali, lakini si kwa haki; \q katikati ya siku zake mali hiyo itamwacha, \q na mwishoni mwake atakuwa mpumbavu.
sw.B: Kama kwale anayeatamia mayai ambayo hakuyataga kamwe, \q ndivyo alivyo mtu anayetajirika kwa njia zisizo za haki; \q katikati ya maisha yake mali itamwacha, \q na mwishowe ataonekana kuwa mpumbavu.
sw.R: Mtu anayetajirika kwa kudanganya \q ni kama ndege anayeatamia mayai ambayo hakuyataga. \q Kabla maisha yake hayajafika nusu, mali yake itakuwa imetoweka, \q na mwishowe kila mtu ataona jinsi alivyokuwa mpumbavu.

vi.L: [Như] chim đa đa ấp trứng mà nó không đẻ, \q [ấy là] người làm giàu nhưng chẳng bởi lẽ công bình; \q giữa đời mình, của cải sẽ lìa bỏ người ấy, \q và cuối cùng người ấy sẽ là kẻ dại dột.
vi.B: Như chim đa đa ấp những trứng nó không đẻ, \q ấy là người làm giàu bằng cách bất chính; \q nửa đời người, của cải sẽ bỏ người ấy mà đi, \q và cuối cùng người ấy sẽ lộ ra là kẻ dại dột.
vi.R: Người làm giàu bằng cách lừa gạt \q giống như con chim ấp những trứng không phải do nó đẻ. \q Chưa đến nửa đời, của cải người ấy sẽ mất hết, \q và cuối cùng mọi người sẽ thấy người ấy dại dột biết bao.

ko.L: 자기가 낳지 않은 알을 품는 자고새처럼, \q 정의롭지 않게 재물을 모으는 사람이 있다. \q 그의 날들의 절반에 그것이 그를 떠날 것이고, \q 그의 마지막에 그는 어리석은 자가 될 것이다.
ko.B: 자기가 낳지도 않은 알을 품는 자고새와 같이, \q 부당하게 부자가 되는 사람이 있다. \q 인생의 한창때에 그 재물이 그를 떠날 것이고, \q 마침내 그는 어리석은 사람으로 드러날 것이다.
ko.R: 남을 속여서 부자가 되는 사람은 \q 자기가 낳지 않은 알을 품고 앉아 있는 새와 같다. \q 그의 인생이 절반도 지나기 전에 재물이 다 없어질 것이다. \q 결국 그가 얼마나 어리석었는지 모두가 알게 될 것이다.

pt.L: [Como] a perdiz que choca o que não pôs, \q [assim é] quem ajunta riqueza, mas não com justiça; \q na metade dos seus dias ela o deixará, \q e no seu fim ele será um insensato.
pt.B: Como a perdiz que choca ovos que não pôs \q é quem enriquece por meios injustos; \q na metade da vida a riqueza o abandonará, \q e no fim ele se mostrará um insensato.
pt.R: Uma pessoa que fica rica enganando os outros \q é como um pássaro chocando ovos que não pôs. \q Antes de chegar à metade da vida, a sua riqueza vai sumir, \q e no fim todos vão ver como ela foi tola.

decisions.choice: a partridge that hatches what it did not lay: a bird sitting on eggs that are not its own
alternatives: a bird that gathers a brood it did not hatch
decisions.reason: The bird (qore', "the caller", from its cry; 1 Samuel 26:20) is most likely a partridge. The verb (dagar) is rare; it seems to mean gathering eggs together and sitting on them. The saying may reflect a belief that this bird took the eggs of other birds, and that the chicks left her once hatched. The exact sense of both words is not certain, but the point of the picture is plain: what was gained wrongly will not stay.

decisions.choice: a fool: a person who lives without regard for God and right
decisions.reason: The word (naval) does not mean someone of low intelligence but someone who acts as if God and right did not matter (Psalm 14:1; 1 Samuel 25:25). The rich cheat will be shown up as such a person when his wealth is gone.

decisions.choice: it will leave him: the wealth leaves the man, as the chicks leave the bird
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject. It is the wealth gained by injustice, which slips away, just as the young birds go off and leave the one that hatched them.

decisions.choice: Like ... is the one who / A person who ... is like
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets the two pictures side by side without "like"; every level supplies the comparison (in brackets at Literal).

decisions.choice: they / them, with "he / him" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The saying is about anyone who gets rich unjustly.

decisions.choice: kwale
decisions.reason: "Kwale", the partridge or francolin of East Africa, a ground bird like the Hebrew qore'; "kware" is the quail.

source.text: כִּסֵּ֣א כָב֔וֹד מָר֖וֹם מֵֽרִאשׁ֑וֹן מְק֖וֹם מִקְדָּשֵֽׁנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: [A] throne of glory, on high from [the] first, [is the] place of our sanctuary.

en.L: A throne of glory, on high from the first, \q [is] the place of our sanctuary.
en.B: A glorious throne, raised high from the very beginning, \q is the place where our sanctuary stands.
en.R: The place of our temple is a glorious throne. \q It has been raised up high from the very beginning.

es.L: Trono de gloria, excelso desde el principio, \q [es] el lugar de nuestro santuario.
es.B: Un trono glorioso, exaltado desde el principio, \q es el lugar donde está nuestro santuario.
es.R: El lugar de nuestro templo es un trono glorioso. \q Ha estado en lo alto desde el principio.

fr.L: Un trône de gloire, élevé dès le commencement, \q [est] le lieu de notre sanctuaire.
fr.B: Un trône glorieux, élevé dès l’origine, \q voilà le lieu où se trouve notre sanctuaire.
fr.R: Le lieu de notre temple est un trône glorieux. \q Il a été élevé très haut dès le commencement.

sw.L: Kiti cha enzi cha utukufu, kilichoinuka juu tangu mwanzo, \q [ndipo] mahali pa patakatifu petu.
sw.B: Kiti cha enzi cha utukufu, kilichoinuliwa juu tangu mwanzo kabisa, \q ndipo mahali palipo patakatifu petu.
sw.R: Mahali lilipo hekalu letu ni kiti cha enzi chenye utukufu. \q Kimeinuliwa juu tangu mwanzo kabisa.

vi.L: Ngai vinh quang, được tôn cao từ ban đầu, \q [là] nơi đền thánh của chúng con.
vi.B: Một ngai vinh hiển, được nâng cao từ thuở ban đầu, \q đó là nơi đền thánh của chúng con đứng.
vi.R: Nơi đền thờ của chúng con là một ngai vinh hiển. \q Nó đã được nâng cao từ thuở ban đầu.

ko.L: 처음부터 높이 있는 영광의 보좌, \q [그것이] 우리 성소의 자리입니다.
ko.B: 처음부터 높이 세워진 영광스러운 보좌, \q 그곳이 우리 성소가 있는 곳입니다.
ko.R: 우리 성전이 있는 곳은 영광스러운 보좌입니다. \q 그곳은 처음부터 높이 세워져 있었습니다.

pt.L: Trono de glória, elevado desde o princípio, \q [é] o lugar do nosso santuário.
pt.B: Um trono glorioso, exaltado desde o princípio, \q é o lugar onde está o nosso santuário.
pt.R: O lugar do nosso templo é um trono glorioso. \q Ele foi colocado lá no alto desde o começo.

decisions.choice: a throne of glory ... is the place of our sanctuary: the temple is the throne of God
alternatives: an address to God continuing into verse 13
decisions.reason: The verse has no verb. It is most naturally read as a statement that the temple, on its height, is the throne of God's glory (3:17; 14:21). It can also be read as the start of an address to God that runs on into verse 13: "Throne of glory ... place of our sanctuary, Hope of Israel, LORD".

decisions.choice: throne of glory: the place where God reigns as king
decisions.reason: The ark in the temple was spoken of as God's throne or footstool (1 Samuel 4:4; Psalm 99:1, 5), and Jerusalem itself is to be called "the throne of the LORD" (3:17). After the curse on those who trust in humans (verse 5), the speaker turns to the place that stands for God's rule from of old.

decisions.choice: on high from the first: exalted since the beginning
decisions.reason: The temple mount is lifted up both in height and in honor, and has been from the earliest times. "On high" can also mean heaven, God's true throne, of which the temple is the earthly sign.

decisions.choice: The place of our temple is a glorious throne. It has been raised up high
decisions.reason: Readable makes the verse two sentences, puts the place of the temple first, and says "temple" for "sanctuary".

decisions.choice: 합쇼체 from verse 12, Jeremiah's lament to God (17:12-18)
alternatives: | Verses 12-13 praise God and lead into Jeremiah's prayer (14-18), so Korean uses the speech of prayer from here on.

source.text: מִקְוֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יְהוָ֔ה כָּל־עֹזְבֶ֖יךָ יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ וְסוּרַי֙ בָּאָ֣רֶץ יִכָּתֵ֔בוּ כִּ֥י עָזְב֛וּ מְק֥וֹר מַֽיִם־חַיִּ֖ים אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Hope of Israel, Yahweh, all forsaking you will be ashamed; and [those] turning away from me in the earth will be written, for they have forsaken [the] fountain of water living, Yahweh.

en.L: Hope of Israel, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q all who forsake {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will be put to shame; \q those who turn away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} will be written in the earth, \q for they have forsaken the spring of living waters, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, Hope of Israel, \q all who desert {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will be put to shame. \q Those who turn from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} will have their names written in the dust, \q because they have deserted {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the spring of living water.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the hope of Israel. \q Everyone who leaves {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will be put to shame. \q Those who turn away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} will be like names written in the dust, \q for they have left {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the spring of living water.

es.L: Esperanza de Israel, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q todos los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} abandonan serán avergonzados; \q los que se apartan de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} serán escritos en la tierra, \q porque han abandonado la fuente de aguas vivas, {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Esperanza de Israel, \q todos los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} abandonan quedarán avergonzados. \q Los que se apartan de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} tendrán sus nombres escritos en el polvo, \q porque han abandonado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, la fuente de agua viva.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres la esperanza de Israel. \q Todos los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dejan quedarán en vergüenza. \q Los que se apartan de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} serán como nombres escritos en el polvo, \q porque han dejado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, la fuente de agua viva.

fr.L: Espérance d’Israël, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}abandonnent seront couverts de honte ; \q ceux qui se détournent de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} seront inscrits dans la terre, \q car ils ont abandonné la source des eaux vives, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Espérance d’Israël, \q tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}abandonnent seront couverts de honte. \q Ceux qui se détournent de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} auront leur nom écrit dans la poussière, \q parce qu’ils ont abandonné {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, la source d’eau vive.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es l’espérance d’Israël. \q Tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} quittent seront couverts de honte. \q Ceux qui se détournent de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} seront comme des noms écrits dans la poussière, \q car ils ont quitté {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, la source d’eau vive.

sw.L: Ee Tumaini la Israeli, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q wote wanaokuacha {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} wataaibishwa; \q wanaojitenga {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} wataandikwa katika nchi, \q kwa maana wamemwacha chemchemi ya maji ya uzima, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Tumaini la Israeli, \q wote wanaokuacha wataaibishwa. \q Wale wanaogeuka kuniacha majina yao yataandikwa mavumbini, \q kwa sababu wamemwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, chemchemi ya maji yaliyo hai.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiye tumaini la Israeli. \q Kila mtu anayekuacha ataaibishwa. \q Wale wanaogeuka kuniacha watakuwa kama majina yaliyoandikwa mavumbini, \q kwa sababu wamemwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, chemchemi ya maji yaliyo hai.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Niềm Hy Vọng của Y-sơ-ra-ên, \q mọi kẻ lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ bị hổ thẹn; \q những kẻ quay lìa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bị ghi tên trong đất, \q vì chúng đã lìa bỏ nguồn nước sống, là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Niềm Hy Vọng của Y-sơ-ra-ên, \q mọi kẻ từ bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ bị hổ thẹn. \q Những kẻ quay lìa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bị ghi tên trong bụi đất, \q vì chúng đã từ bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là nguồn nước sống.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là niềm hy vọng của Y-sơ-ra-ên. \q Ai lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ bị hổ thẹn. \q Những kẻ quay lưng với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ như những cái tên viết trên bụi đất, \q vì chúng đã lìa bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là nguồn nước sống.

ko.L: 이스라엘의 소망이신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, \q 주님을 버리는 자들은 모두 수치를 당할 것입니다. \q 나에게서 돌아서는 자들은 땅에 기록될 것이다. \q 그들이 생수의 샘이신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 버렸기 때문이다.
ko.B: 이스라엘의 소망이신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, \q 주님을 저버리는 자들은 모두 수치를 당할 것입니다. \q 나를 떠나는 자들의 이름은 흙 위에 기록될 것이다. \q 그들이 생수의 샘이신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 저버렸기 때문이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님은 이스라엘의 소망이십니다. \q 주님을 떠나는 사람은 모두 부끄러움을 당할 것입니다. \q 나를 떠나는 자들은 흙 위에 쓴 이름처럼 될 것이다. \q 그들이 생수의 샘이신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 떠났기 때문이다.

pt.L: Esperança de Israel, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q todos os que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} abandonam serão envergonhados; \q os que se desviam de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} serão escritos na terra, \q pois abandonaram a fonte de águas vivas, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, Esperança de Israel, \q todos os que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} deixam serão envergonhados. \q Os que se afastam de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} terão o nome escrito no pó, \q porque deixaram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, a nascente de água viva.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és a esperança de Israel. \q Todos os que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} deixam vão passar vergonha. \q Os que se afastam de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} serão como nomes escritos no pó, \q pois deixaram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, a nascente de água viva.

decisions.choice: Hope of Israel: a title of God, as in 14:8
decisions.reason: Jeremiah calls on God by this title in his prayer during the drought (14:8), and 50:7 calls the LORD "the hope of their fathers". The word (miqweh) means hope or what one waits for, and it can also mean a pool of water, which may prepare for the spring at the end of the verse.

decisions.choice: those who turn away from me: the LORD himself speaks in this line
decisions.reason: The verse begins as a prayer to the LORD ("all who forsake you") and then says "from me", as if God himself answers within the prayer, before speaking of "the LORD" again at the end. Such shifts are common in the prophets. Some read "from you" by a slight change, keeping the whole verse as prayer; others take "me" to be the prophet. The written consonants begin the word with a different letter from the form read aloud ("and those who turn away from me"); the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: written in the earth: recorded where the writing soon disappears, among the dead
alternatives: written for the underworld (marked for death)
decisions.reason: Names written in dust or soil are soon wiped away, the opposite of a name kept in God's book (Exodus 32:32-33; Psalm 69:29). "The earth" can also mean the underworld, the place of the dead, so the line may mean they are marked out for death. It stands in sharp contrast to Judah's sin, engraved with iron and diamond (verse 1).

decisions.choice: the spring of living water: the LORD as the source of life, as in 2:13
decisions.reason: In 2:13 God says his people "have forsaken me, the spring of living water" and dug broken cisterns instead; each level words the phrase as there. "Living water" is fresh, flowing water from a spring, set against still water stored in a pit.

decisions.choice: the LORD, the spring of living water
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew order, with the name last; Balanced and Readable put the name first so that "spring" is clearly a title of the LORD.

decisions.choice: written in the dust / like names written in the dust
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "dust" for "earth" to make the picture of writing that is soon wiped away (m3), and both add "names".

decisions.choice: "la fuente de aguas vivas" (L); "la fuente de agua viva" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 2:13 at each level, as the English points back to it.

decisions.choice: chemchemi ya maji ya uzima (Literal); chemchemi ya maji yaliyo hai (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Worded as in 2:13 at each level (meaning decision m4).

decisions.choice: "la source des eaux vives" (L); "la source d’eau vive" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 2:13 at each level, where the same title of God first appears.

decisions.choice: "nguồn nước sống"
decisions.reason: The wording of 2:13, kept so the two verses can be seen together.

decisions.choice: the second half of the verse in the plain style, as God's own words
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from "you" to "me" in mid-verse, which most readily reads as God answering inside the prayer. Korean marks the change by moving from 합쇼체 to the plain style rather than adding quotation marks.

decisions.choice: Esperança de Israel; a fonte de águas vivas (L), a nascente de água viva (B, R)
decisions.reason: The title takes the words of 14:8 (m1), and the spring repeats 2:13 at each level, as that verse sets them (m4).

source.text: רְפָאֵ֤נִי יְהוָה֙ וְאֵ֣רָפֵ֔א הוֹשִׁיעֵ֖נִי וְאִוָּשֵׁ֑עָה כִּ֥י תְהִלָּתִ֖י אָֽתָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: Heal me, Yahweh, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved; for my praise [are] you.

en.L: Heal me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and I will be healed; \q save me, and I will be saved, \q for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} [are] my praise.
en.B: Heal me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and I will be healed; \q rescue me, and I will be safe; \q for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the one I praise.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, heal me, and I will truly be healed. \q Save me, and I will truly be saved. \q You are the one I praise.

es.L: Sáname, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y seré sanado; \q sálvame, y seré salvo, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [eres] mi alabanza.
es.B: Sáname, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y quedaré sano; \q rescátame, y estaré a salvo; \q porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres a quien alabo.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, sáname, y de verdad quedaré sano. \q Sálvame, y de verdad estaré a salvo. \q Eres tú a quien alabo.

fr.L: Guéris-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et je serai guéri ; \q sauve-moi, et je serai sauvé, \q car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [es] ma louange.
fr.B: Guéris-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et je serai guéri ; \q délivre-moi, et je serai sauvé ; \q car c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} que je loue.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, guéris-moi, et je serai vraiment guéri. \q Sauve-moi, et je serai vraiment sauvé. \q C’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} que je loue.

sw.L: Uniponye, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nami nitaponywa; \q uniokoe, nami nitaokoka, \q kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} [ndiwe] sifa yangu.
sw.B: Uniponye, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nami nitapona; \q uniokoe, nami nitakuwa salama; \q kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe ninayekusifu.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uniponye, nami nitapona kweli. \q Uniokoe, nami nitaokoka kweli. \q Wewe ndiwe ninayekusifu.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin chữa lành con, thì con sẽ được lành; \q xin cứu con, thì con sẽ được cứu, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] sự ca ngợi của con.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin chữa lành con, thì con sẽ được lành; \q xin giải cứu con, thì con sẽ được an toàn; \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng con ca ngợi.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin chữa lành con, thì con sẽ thật sự được lành. \q Xin cứu con, thì con sẽ thật sự được cứu. \q Ngài là Đấng con ca ngợi.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 고쳐 주십시오. 그러면 제가 나을 것입니다. \q 저를 구원해 주십시오. 그러면 제가 구원받을 것입니다. \q 주님은 저의 찬양이십니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 고쳐 주십시오. 그러면 제가 낫겠습니다. \q 저를 구해 주십시오. 그러면 제가 살겠습니다. \q 주님은 제가 찬양하는 분이십니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 고쳐 주십시오. 그러면 제가 정말로 나을 것입니다. \q 저를 구원해 주십시오. 그러면 제가 정말로 구원받을 것입니다. \q 주님은 제가 찬양하는 분이십니다.

pt.L: Cura-me, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, e serei curado; \q salva-me, e serei salvo, \q pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [és] o meu louvor.
pt.B: Cura-me, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, e serei curado; \q livra-me, e estarei a salvo; \q pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és aquele a quem eu louvo.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, cura-me, e eu serei curado de verdade. \q Salva-me, e eu serei salvo de verdade. \q Tu és aquele a quem eu louvo.

decisions.choice: the start of Jeremiah's third lament: his prayer for healing and help against those who mock him
decisions.reason: Verses 14-18 are the third of Jeremiah's prayers of complaint to God (11:18-12:6; 15:10-21; 17:14-18; 18:18-23; 20:7-18). Like the psalms of lament, it asks for help, protests the prophet's faithfulness, and calls on God to act against his enemies.

decisions.choice: and I will be healed ... and I will be saved: only God's healing is real healing
decisions.reason: Each request is followed by the same verb in the passive. If God heals, the healing will be complete and true. After verse 9, where the heart is incurable, the prophet looks to the one who can heal (compare 15:18, where he calls his own wound incurable; 30:17).

decisions.choice: you are my praise: the one I praise
decisions.reason: The phrase means that God is the subject of the prophet's praise (Deuteronomy 10:21; Psalm 109:1). It gives the reason he can ask with confidence.

decisions.choice: rescue me, and I will be safe
decisions.reason: Balanced uses "rescue" and "safe" for the two forms of the Hebrew verb "save", which here means being delivered from danger. Literal and Readable keep "save ... saved".

decisions.choice: truly healed / truly saved
decisions.reason: Readable adds "truly" to bring out the point of the repeated verb (m2).

decisions.choice: Jeremiah speaks to God as "tú"
decisions.reason: This opens Jeremiah's third lament (17:14-18), his own prayer for healing and help against those who mock him.

decisions.choice: first person, no quotation marks
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's third lament (17:14-18) is his prayer and is set without quotation marks, as at 11:18 and 15:10.

decisions.choice: tenses of speech in Jeremiah's lament (17:14-18)
decisions.reason: As in his other laments, Jeremiah's prayer takes the tenses of speech at every level.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah's third lament (17:14-18): "lạy CHÚA", "con", "Ngài"
decisions.reason: Jeremiah prays for himself against those who mock him, in the prayer forms of the terms note, as in his earlier laments (11:18; 15:15).

decisions.choice: tu, with deity_pronoun spans (Jeremiah's third lament, verses 14-18)
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's third prayer of complaint begins here (m1). As in 11:18 and 15:15, he speaks to God with "tu" at every level; the imperatives "Cura-me", "salva-me", "livra-me" are the "tu" forms.

source.text: הִנֵּה־הֵ֕מָּה אֹמְרִ֖ים אֵלָ֑י אַיֵּ֥ה דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה יָ֥בוֹא נָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, they [are] saying to me: Where [is the] word of Yahweh? Let it come, please!

en.L: Look, they are saying to me, \q "Where [is] the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? Let it come, now!"
en.B: See how they taunt me: \q "Where is the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? Let it come true, then!"
en.R: People keep saying to me, \q "Where is the disaster {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke about? Let it happen now!"

es.L: He aquí, ellos me dicen: \q «¿Dónde [está] la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? ¡Que venga ahora!».
es.B: Mira cómo se burlan de mí: \q «¿Dónde está la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? ¡Pues que se cumpla!».
es.R: La gente me dice una y otra vez: \q «¿Dónde está la desgracia de la que habló {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}? ¡Que suceda ya!».

fr.L: Voici, ils me disent : \q « Où [est] la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? Qu’elle vienne donc ! »
fr.B: Vois comme ils me narguent : \q « Où est la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? Qu’elle s’accomplisse donc ! »
fr.R: Les gens ne cessent de me dire : \q « Où est le malheur dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a parlé ? Qu’il arrive maintenant ! »

sw.L: Tazama, wao wananiambia, \q "Liko wapi neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Na lije sasa!"
sw.B: Tazama jinsi wanavyonidhihaki: \q "Liko wapi neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Basi na litimie!"
sw.R: Watu wanaendelea kuniambia, \q "Yako wapi maafa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema yatakuja? Na yaje sasa!"

vi.L: Kìa, chúng nói với con: \q "Lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở đâu? Hãy để nó đến đi!"
vi.B: Kìa, chúng chế nhạo con: \q "Lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở đâu? Cứ để nó xảy ra xem nào!"
vi.R: Người ta cứ nói với con: \q "Tai họa {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nói ở đâu? Hãy để nó xảy ra ngay đi!"

ko.L: 보십시오, 그들이 저에게 말합니다. \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 어디 있느냐? 이제 이루어져 보라고 하여라!"
ko.B: 그들이 저를 비웃으며 말합니다. \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 어디 있느냐? 어디 한번 이루어져 보라고 하여라!"
ko.R: 사람들이 저에게 늘 말합니다. \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 재앙이 어디 있느냐? 지금 일어나 보라고 하여라!"

pt.L: Eis que eles me dizem: \q "Onde [está] a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}? Que venha, então!"
pt.B: Vê como zombam de mim: \q "Onde está a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}? Que se cumpra, então!"
pt.R: O povo vive me dizendo: \q "Onde está a desgraça de que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou? Que aconteça agora!"

decisions.choice: where is the word of the LORD? let it come: a taunt that the prophet's warnings have not come true
decisions.reason: The mockers ask where the disaster is that Jeremiah keeps announcing. If it does not come, he is a false prophet by the test of Deuteronomy 18:21-22. Isaiah's hearers mocked in the same way (Isaiah 5:19), and so did those of Ezekiel (Ezekiel 12:22).

decisions.choice: please / now: a word that urges
decisions.reason: The small word (na') presses the request: "come on, let it come". In the mockers' mouths it is a dare.

decisions.choice: the disaster the LORD spoke about
decisions.reason: Readable says what "the word" refers to: the disaster Jeremiah had foretold (m1).

source.text: וַאֲנִ֞י לֹא־אַ֣צְתִּי׀מֵרֹעֶ֣ה אַחֲרֶ֗יךָ וְי֥וֹם אָנ֛וּשׁ לֹ֥א הִתְאַוֵּ֖יתִי אַתָּ֣ה יָדָ֑עְתָּ מוֹצָ֣א שְׂפָתַ֔י נֹ֥כַח פָּנֶ֖יךָ הָיָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: But I, not I have hurried from [being a] shepherd after you, and [the] incurable day not I have longed for; you, you know; [the] going out of my lips before your face was.

en.L: But I have not hurried away from being a shepherd after {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and the day of disaster I have not longed for; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know [it]; \q what came out of my lips was before {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face.
en.B: But I have not run away from being a shepherd who follows {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; I have not longed for the day of disaster, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know it. \q Every word that left my lips was spoken openly before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: I did not run away from being a shepherd who serves {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q I never wanted the day of disaster to come; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know that. \q Every word I spoke, I spoke in front of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

es.L: Pero yo no me he apresurado a dejar de ser pastor en pos de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, ni he deseado el día de la desgracia; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [lo] sabes; \q lo que salió de mis labios estuvo delante de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro.
es.B: Pero yo no he huido de ser un pastor que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} sigue; no he deseado el día de la desgracia, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} lo sabes. \q Cada palabra que salió de mis labios fue dicha abiertamente delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: Yo no huí de ser un pastor que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} sirve. \q Nunca quise que llegara el día de la desgracia; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} lo sabes. \q Cada palabra que dije, la dije delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

fr.L: Mais moi, je ne me suis pas hâté de cesser d’être berger à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} suite, et le jour du malheur, je ne l’ai pas désiré ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le sais ; \q ce qui est sorti de mes lèvres était devant {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face.
fr.B: Mais je ne me suis pas dérobé à ma tâche de berger qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} suit ; je n’ai pas souhaité le jour du malheur, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le sais. \q Chaque parole sortie de mes lèvres a été dite ouvertement devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Je n’ai pas fui ma tâche de berger à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} service. \q Je n’ai jamais voulu que le jour du malheur arrive ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le sais. \q Chaque parole que j’ai dite, je l’ai dite devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Lakini mimi sikuharakisha kuacha kuwa mchungaji anayekufuata {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, wala siku ya maafa sikuitamani; {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unajua; \q yaliyotoka midomoni mwangu yalikuwa mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Lakini sikukimbia kuacha kuwa mchungaji anayekufuata {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}; sikuitamani siku ya maafa, nawe unalijua hilo. \q Kila neno lililotoka midomoni mwangu lilisemwa waziwazi mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Sikukimbia kuacha kuwa mchungaji anayekutumikia {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. \q Sikutaka kamwe siku ya maafa ije; {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unajua hilo. \q Kila neno nililosema, nililisema mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

vi.L: Nhưng con đã không vội bỏ việc làm người chăn đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và con đã không mong ngày tai họa; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết [điều đó]; \q những lời ra từ môi con đều ở trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Nhưng con đã không bỏ chạy khỏi việc làm người chăn theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; con không hề mong ngày tai họa, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết điều đó. \q Mọi lời ra từ môi con đều được nói công khai trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Con đã không trốn tránh việc làm người chăn phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Con chưa bao giờ muốn ngày tai họa đến; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết điều đó. \q Mọi lời con nói, con đều nói trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그러나 저는 주님을 따르는 목자의 일에서 서둘러 떠나지 않았고, 재앙의 날을 바라지도 않았습니다. 주님께서 아십니다. \q 제 입술에서 나온 것이 주님 앞에 있습니다.
ko.B: 그러나 저는 주님을 따르는 목자의 일을 버리고 달아나지 않았고, 재앙의 날을 바라지도 않았습니다. 주님께서 그것을 아십니다. \q 제 입술에서 나온 말은 모두 주님 앞에서 드러내 놓고 한 것입니다.
ko.R: 저는 주님을 섬기는 목자의 일을 버리고 달아나지 않았습니다. \q 저는 재앙의 날이 오기를 바란 적이 없습니다. 주님께서 그것을 아십니다. \q 제가 한 말은 모두 주님 앞에서 한 것입니다.

pt.L: Mas eu não me apressei em deixar de ser pastor atrás de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, e o dia da desgraça não desejei; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [o] sabes; \q o que saiu dos meus lábios estava diante da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} face.
pt.B: Mas eu não fugi de ser um pastor que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} segue; não desejei o dia da desgraça, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} o sabes. \q Cada palavra que saiu dos meus lábios foi dita abertamente diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.R: Eu não fugi de ser um pastor que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} serve. \q Nunca quis que chegasse o dia da desgraça; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sabes disso. \q Cada palavra que eu disse, eu disse na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} presença.

decisions.choice: from being a shepherd after you: Jeremiah did not run from his task as God's shepherd of the people
alternatives: I have not pressed you to send disaster (different vowels)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is brief: "from a shepherd after you". It most likely means that Jeremiah has not hurried away from following God as a shepherd of his people, though elsewhere the shepherds are usually the kings and leaders (2:8; 23:1-4). A different set of vowels would give "from evil", "I have not pressed you to bring evil", which matches the next line.

decisions.choice: the day of disaster: literally "the incurable day", the day of judgment
decisions.reason: The word is the one used of the incurable heart in verse 9. The prophet insists that he has not wished for the doom he must announce; the mockers of verse 15 think he wants it to come.

decisions.choice: what came out of my lips was before your face: everything I said was spoken in God's sight
decisions.reason: "Before your face" means in God's presence and knowing. Jeremiah has spoken only what God gave him, openly, with nothing hidden from God.

decisions.choice: who follows you / who serves you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "a shepherd after you" means; Readable makes the shepherd's work a service to God (m1).

source.text: אַל־תִּֽהְיֵה־לִ֖י לִמְחִתָּ֑ה מַֽחֲסִי־אַ֖תָּה בְּי֥וֹם רָעָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Not become to me a terror; my refuge [are] you in [the] day of disaster.

en.L: Do not become a terror to me; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} [are] my refuge in the day of disaster.
en.B: Do not become a terror to me; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are my refuge on the day of disaster.
en.R: Do not become someone I am afraid of, \q because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are where I hide when disaster comes.

es.L: No seas para mí un terror; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [eres] mi refugio en el día de la desgracia.
es.B: No te conviertas en un terror para mí; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres mi refugio en el día de la desgracia.
es.R: No te conviertas en alguien a quien yo tenga miedo, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres mi escondite cuando llega la desgracia.

fr.L: Ne deviens pas pour moi une terreur ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [es] mon refuge au jour du malheur.
fr.B: Ne deviens pas pour moi un sujet d’effroi ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es mon refuge au jour du malheur.
fr.R: Ne deviens pas quelqu’un dont j’aie peur, \q car c’est auprès de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} que je me cache quand vient le malheur.

sw.L: Usiwe kitisho kwangu; \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} [ndiwe] kimbilio langu siku ya maafa.
sw.B: Usiwe kitisho kwangu; \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe kimbilio langu siku ya maafa.
sw.R: Usiwe mtu ninayemwogopa, \q kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe mahali ninapojificha maafa yanapokuja.

vi.L: Xin đừng trở nên nỗi kinh hoàng cho con; \q Ngài [là] nơi ẩn náu của con trong ngày tai họa.
vi.B: Xin đừng trở nên nỗi kinh hoàng cho con; \q Ngài là nơi ẩn náu của con trong ngày tai họa.
vi.R: Xin đừng trở thành Đấng con phải sợ hãi, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là nơi con ẩn náu khi tai họa đến.

ko.L: 저에게 공포가 되지 마십시오. \q 주님은 재앙의 날에 저의 피난처이십니다.
ko.B: 저에게 두려움이 되지 마십시오. \q 주님은 재앙의 날에 저의 피난처이십니다.
ko.R: 제가 두려워하는 분이 되지 마십시오. \q 재앙이 닥칠 때 제가 숨을 곳은 주님이시기 때문입니다.

pt.L: Não sejas para mim motivo de pavor; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [és] o meu refúgio no dia da desgraça.
pt.B: Não sejas um terror para mim; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és o meu refúgio no dia da desgraça.
pt.R: Não sejas alguém de quem eu tenha medo, \q pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és o lugar onde me escondo quando vem a desgraça.

decisions.choice: a terror: the word God used in calling Jeremiah
decisions.reason: At his call God told Jeremiah, "Do not be dismayed before them, or I will dismay you before them" (1:17). The word "terror" comes from that root, and verse 18 uses the verb again ("let them be dismayed"). The prophet asks that God himself not become a source of dread to him.

decisions.choice: refuge: a shelter from danger
decisions.reason: The word is used of a place to hide from storm (Isaiah 4:6) and often of God as a shelter for those who trust him (Psalm 46:2; 62:8).

decisions.choice: someone I am afraid of / where I hide
decisions.reason: Readable explains "terror" and "refuge" in plain words.

decisions.choice: pavor (L); apavorados (L), abatidos (B), cheios de pavor (R) in verse 18
decisions.reason: The noun and the verb of verse 18 come from the root God used at Jeremiah's call (m1; 1:17), so each level takes the word 1:17 set for it: "apavorar" at Literal, "abater" at Balanced, "encher de pavor" at Readable. The reader can hear Jeremiah turn God's warning into a prayer.

source.text: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ רֹדְפַי֙ וְאַל־אֵבֹ֣שָׁה אָ֔נִי יֵחַ֣תּוּ הֵ֔מָּה וְאַל־אֵחַ֖תָּה אָ֑נִי הָבִ֤יא עֲלֵיהֶם֙ י֣וֹם רָעָ֔ה וּמִשְׁנֶ֥ה שִׁבָּר֖וֹן שָׁבְרֵֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Let be put to shame my persecutors, and not let me be put to shame, I; let them be dismayed, they, and not let me be dismayed, I; bring on them [the] day of disaster, and [with] double breaking break them.

en.L: Let my persecutors be put to shame, but let me not be put to shame; \q let them be dismayed, \q but let me not be dismayed; \q bring on them the day of disaster, \q and break them with double breaking.
en.B: Let those who hunt me down be put to shame, but do not let me be shamed; \q let them be shattered with fear, \q but do not let me be shattered. \q Bring the day of disaster on them, \q and crush them twice over.
en.R: Let the people who chase after me be put to shame, but do not let me be ashamed. \q Let them be terrified, but keep me from being terrified. \q Bring the day of disaster on them, \q and destroy them twice over.

es.L: Sean avergonzados mis perseguidores, pero no sea avergonzado yo; \q sean aterrados ellos, \q pero no sea aterrado yo; \q trae sobre ellos el día de la desgracia, \q y quebrántalos con doble quebranto.
es.B: Que queden en vergüenza los que me persiguen, pero no me dejes avergonzado a mí; \q que ellos se llenen de terror, \q pero no me dejes aterrado a mí. \q Trae sobre ellos el día de la desgracia, \q y destrúyelos dos veces.
es.R: Que queden en vergüenza los que me persiguen, pero que yo no quede avergonzado. \q Que ellos se llenen de terror, pero no dejes que yo tenga miedo. \q Trae sobre ellos el día de la desgracia, \q y destrúyelos por partida doble.

fr.L: Que mes persécuteurs soient couverts de honte, mais que moi, je ne sois pas couvert de honte ; \q qu’ils soient consternés, eux, \q mais que moi, je ne sois pas consterné ; \q fais venir sur eux le jour du malheur, \q et brise-les d’une double brisure.
fr.B: Que ceux qui me pourchassent soient couverts de honte, mais ne me laisse pas dans la honte ; \q qu’ils soient brisés de peur, \q mais ne me laisse pas briser. \q Fais venir sur eux le jour du malheur, \q et écrase-les deux fois.
fr.R: Que les gens qui me poursuivent soient couverts de honte, mais ne me laisse pas avoir honte. \q Qu’ils soient terrifiés, mais garde-moi de la terreur. \q Fais venir sur eux le jour du malheur, \q et détruis-les deux fois.

sw.L: Waaibishwe wanaonifuatia, lakini mimi nisiaibishwe; \q wafadhaike wao, \q lakini mimi nisifadhaike; \q uwaletee siku ya maafa, \q uwavunje kwa uvunjifu maradufu.
sw.B: Waaibishwe wale wanaoniwinda, lakini usiniache niaibishwe; \q wavunjike kwa hofu wao, \q lakini usiniache nivunjike mimi. \q Uwaletee siku ya maafa, \q uwaponde mara mbili.
sw.R: Watu wanaonifukuza waaibishwe, lakini usiniache niaibike. \q Waogope sana wao, lakini unilinde nisiogope. \q Uwaletee siku ya maafa, \q uwaangamize mara mbili.

vi.L: Xin cho những kẻ bắt bớ con bị hổ thẹn, nhưng đừng để con bị hổ thẹn; \q xin cho chúng bị kinh hãi, \q nhưng đừng để con bị kinh hãi; \q xin giáng trên chúng ngày tai họa, \q và đập tan chúng gấp đôi.
vi.B: Xin cho những kẻ săn đuổi con bị hổ thẹn, nhưng đừng để con bị hổ thẹn; \q xin cho chúng khiếp đảm, \q nhưng đừng để con khiếp đảm. \q Xin đem ngày tai họa đến trên chúng, \q và nghiền nát chúng gấp đôi.
vi.R: Xin cho những kẻ đuổi theo con bị hổ thẹn, nhưng đừng để con bị hổ thẹn. \q Xin cho chúng kinh hoàng, nhưng xin gìn giữ con khỏi kinh hoàng. \q Xin đem ngày tai họa đến trên chúng, \q và hủy diệt chúng gấp đôi.

ko.L: 저를 박해하는 자들은 수치를 당하게 하시고, 저는 수치를 당하지 않게 해 주십시오. \q 그들은 놀라게 하시고, \q 저는 놀라지 않게 해 주십시오. \q 그들에게 재앙의 날을 내리시고, \q 갑절의 파멸로 그들을 부수십시오.
ko.B: 저를 뒤쫓는 자들은 부끄러움을 당하게 하시고, 저는 부끄러움을 당하지 않게 해 주십시오. \q 그들은 두려움에 무너지게 하시고, \q 저는 무너지지 않게 해 주십시오. \q 그들에게 재앙의 날을 내리시고, \q 그들을 두 배로 부수어 주십시오.
ko.R: 저를 쫓아다니는 사람들은 부끄러움을 당하게 하시고, 저는 부끄러움을 당하지 않게 해 주십시오. \q 그들은 겁에 질리게 하시고, 저는 겁에 질리지 않게 해 주십시오. \q 그들에게 재앙의 날을 내리시고, \q 그들을 두 배로 멸해 주십시오.

pt.L: Que os meus perseguidores sejam envergonhados, mas que eu não seja envergonhado; \q que eles sejam apavorados, \q mas que eu não seja apavorado; \q traze sobre eles o dia da desgraça, \q e quebra-os com dupla quebra.
pt.B: Que os que me perseguem sejam envergonhados, mas não deixes que eu seja envergonhado; \q que eles sejam abatidos pelo medo, \q mas não deixes que eu seja abatido. \q Traze sobre eles o dia da desgraça, \q e esmaga-os duas vezes.
pt.R: Que as pessoas que me perseguem sejam envergonhadas, mas não deixes que eu passe vergonha. \q Que elas fiquem cheias de pavor, mas não deixes que eu fique cheio de pavor. \q Traze sobre elas o dia da desgraça, \q e destrói-as duas vezes.

decisions.choice: they ... I: the pronouns are stressed, setting the prophet against his enemies
decisions.reason: The Hebrew adds "they" and "I" where the verbs already show the person, stressing the contrast: shame for them, not for me.

decisions.choice: double breaking: full and complete destruction
decisions.reason: "Double" means a full measure, the punishment their sin deserves (16:18; Isaiah 40:2). The verb and the noun come from the same root, "break them with breaking", which adds force.

decisions.choice: bring on them the day of disaster: a prayer that God's justice be done
decisions.reason: In verse 16 Jeremiah says he has not longed for the day of disaster for the people; here he asks God to bring it on those who mock and persecute him for speaking God's word. Such prayers, found also in the psalms (Psalm 35:4-8; 109), hand vengeance over to God rather than taking it into one's own hands (11:20).

decisions.choice: hunt me down / chase after me; crush them twice over
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use plain words for "pursue" and give the sense of "double breaking" (m2).

source.text: כֹּה־אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י הָלֹ֤ךְ וְעָֽמַדְתָּ֙ בְּשַׁ֣עַר בְּנֵֽי־הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָבֹ֤אוּ בוֹ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַאֲשֶׁ֖ר יֵ֣צְאוּ ב֑וֹ וּבְכֹ֖ל שַׁעֲרֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus said Yahweh to me: Go, and you will stand in [the] gate of [the] sons of the people, which enter by it [the] kings of Judah and which they go out by it, and in all [the] gates of Jerusalem.

en.L: Thus said {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to me: "Go, and stand in the gate of the sons of the people, by which the kings of Judah come in and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said this to me: "Go and take your stand in the People's Gate, the gate the kings of Judah use when they enter and leave, and then in all the gates of Jerusalem.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me: "Go and take your place at the People's Gate, where the kings of Judah go in and out of the city. Then stand at all the other gates of Jerusalem too.

es.L: Así me dijo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: «Ve y ponte en la puerta de los hijos del pueblo, por la cual entran los reyes de Judá y por la cual salen, y en todas las puertas de Jerusalén.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo esto: «Ve y colócate en la Puerta del Pueblo, la puerta que usan los reyes de Judá para entrar y salir, y luego en todas las puertas de Jerusalén.
es.R: Esto es lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: «Ve y ponte en la Puerta del Pueblo, por donde los reyes de Judá entran y salen de la ciudad. Luego ponte también en todas las demás puertas de Jerusalén.

fr.L: Ainsi me parla {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : « Va, et tiens-toi à la porte des fils du peuple, par laquelle entrent les rois de Juda et par laquelle ils sortent, et à toutes les portes de Jérusalem.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me dit ceci : « Va te placer à la porte du Peuple, celle par où les rois de Juda entrent et sortent, puis à toutes les portes de Jérusalem.
fr.R: Voici ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : « Va te mettre à la porte du Peuple, par où les rois de Juda entrent et sortent de la ville. Ensuite, tiens-toi aussi à toutes les autres portes de Jérusalem.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniambia hivi: "Nenda ukasimame katika lango la wana wa watu, ambalo wafalme wa Yuda huingia kwalo na kutoka kwalo, na katika malango yote ya Yerusalemu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniambia hivi: "Nenda ukasimame kwenye Lango la Watu, lango wanalotumia wafalme wa Yuda wanapoingia na kutoka, kisha katika malango yote ya Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliloniambia: "Nenda ukasimame kwenye Lango la Watu, mahali wafalme wa Yuda wanapoingia na kutoka mjini. Kisha simama katika malango mengine yote ya Yerusalemu pia.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với tôi thế này: "Hãy đi và đứng tại cổng của con cái dân chúng, là cổng các vua Giu-đa đi vào và đi ra, cùng tại mọi cổng của Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với tôi như vầy: "Hãy đi và đứng tại Cổng Dân Chúng, là cổng các vua Giu-đa dùng khi ra vào, rồi tại mọi cổng của Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với tôi: "Hãy đi và đứng tại Cổng Dân Chúng, nơi các vua Giu-đa ra vào thành. Rồi hãy đứng tại tất cả các cổng khác của Giê-ru-sa-lem nữa.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 이와 같이 말씀하셨다. "가서 유다의 왕들이 들어가고 나가는 백성의 자손들의 문과 예루살렘의 모든 문에 서라.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 이렇게 말씀하셨다. "가서 유다 왕들이 드나드는 '백성의 문'에 서고, 그다음에 예루살렘의 모든 문에 서라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 하신 말씀이다. "가서 유다 왕들이 성을 드나드는 '백성의 문'에 서라. 그다음에는 예루살렘의 다른 모든 문에도 서라.

pt.L: Assim me disse {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: "Vai e põe-te na porta dos filhos do povo, pela qual entram os reis de Judá e pela qual saem, e em todas as portas de Jerusalém.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: "Vai e fica de pé na Porta do Povo, a porta que os reis de Judá usam para entrar e sair, e depois em todas as portas de Jerusalém.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: "Vai e fica na Porta do Povo, por onde os reis de Judá entram e saem da cidade. Depois fica também em todas as outras portas de Jerusalém.

decisions.choice: a new message in prose: God sends Jeremiah to preach about the Sabbath (verses 19-27)
decisions.reason: The poetry ends with verse 18, and a prose sermon begins, like those at the temple gate (7:1-15) and about the covenant (11:1-17). God speaks to Jeremiah from here to the end of the chapter; the words Jeremiah is to proclaim begin at "Hear" in verse 20.

decisions.choice: the gate of the sons of the people: a city gate named for the ordinary people, used also by the kings
alternatives: the Benjamin Gate (by a change of letters)
decisions.reason: No gate of this name is mentioned anywhere else, and where it stood is not known. "Sons of the people" means the common people, as in 26:23. Some suggest it is the Benjamin Gate (37:13; 38:7) by a small change of the letters. The written consonants have "sons of a people"; the scribes marked "sons of the people" to be read.

decisions.choice: the kings of Judah: the king and the royal house
decisions.reason: The plural speaks of the house of David as a whole, the reigning king and his family and successors, as in 19:3 and 22:2.

decisions.choice: the gate of the sons of the people / the People's Gate
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase; Balanced and Readable give it as a name.

decisions.choice: Thus said the LORD to me / The LORD said this to me / This is what the LORD said to me
decisions.reason: The book's wording for "Thus says the LORD", here in the past tense because the Hebrew tells what God said to Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: "la puerta de los hijos del pueblo" (L); "la Puerta del Pueblo" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase; Balanced and Readable give the gate a name, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "cổng của con cái dân chúng" (Literal); "Cổng Dân Chúng" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the gate as a name, capitalised as Vietnamese writes names of gates, as the English does.

decisions.choice: 백성의 자손들의 문 (Literal); '백성의 문' (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase; Balanced and Readable give it as the gate's name, marked as a name with single quotation marks inside God's words.

pt.B: Dize-lhes: 'Ouçam a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, reis de Judá, todo Judá e todos os que moram em Jerusalém e entram por estas portas.

decisions.choice: all Judah: the people of the land of Judah, as distinct from those of the city
decisions.reason: The message is for everyone who passes through the gates: the royal house, the people of the towns of Judah who came into the city to trade, and the people of Jerusalem itself.

decisions.choice: hear the word of the LORD: the opening of a prophetic sermon
decisions.reason: The same summons opens the temple sermon (7:2) and the message to the house of the king (22:2).

decisions.choice: all you people of Judah
decisions.reason: Readable says that "all Judah" means its people.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 너희 목숨을 위하여 조심하여라. 안식일에 짐을 지고 예루살렘 문들로 들여오지 마라.

ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 너희 목숨이 소중하거든 조심하여라! 안식일에는 짐을 나르지 말고, 그것을 예루살렘 성문으로 들여오지도 마라.

pt.B: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Fiquem atentos, pois a vida de vocês depende disso. Não carreguem nenhuma carga no dia de sábado nem a façam entrar pelas portas de Jerusalém.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: Tenham cuidado, se dão valor à própria vida! Não carreguem cargas no dia de sábado e não as tragam para dentro pelas portas de Jerusalém.

decisions.choice: guard yourselves for your lives: take great care, because your lives are at stake
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean "guard your own selves" or "take care, at the risk of your lives". Either way it is a strong warning: the city's life depends on keeping the Sabbath (verses 25 and 27). Deuteronomy 4:15 uses a similar warning.

decisions.choice: do not carry a burden on the Sabbath day: the Sabbath command applied to trade at the city gates
decisions.reason: The Sabbath command forbids all work on the seventh day (Exodus 20:8-11; Deuteronomy 5:12-15). Carrying loads of goods through the gates was the business of the market, the work of buying and selling. Nehemiah later shut the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath for the same reason (Nehemiah 13:15-22), and Amos condemned those who could not wait for the Sabbath to end to start trading again (Amos 8:5).

decisions.choice: a burden: a load carried on the back or on an animal
decisions.reason: The word (massa') is an ordinary word for a load to be carried (Exodus 23:5; Nehemiah 13:15, 19). The same word can mean an "oracle", a prophetic message, but here it is the plain load.

decisions.choice: burden / load / loads
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the traditional word "burden"; Balanced and Readable say "load", the everyday word for goods carried in to sell.

decisions.choice: "el día de reposo"
decisions.reason: The Sabbath as published in the Spanish of the Gospels and the Law ("el día de reposo"), at every level.

decisions.choice: mzigo; siku ya Sabato
decisions.reason: "Mzigo", a load, at every level, and "Sabato" as 1 Chronicles 23:31.

decisions.choice: "fardeau" (L); "charge" (B, R); "le sabbat" lowercase
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the traditional word, the others the everyday one, as the English does; "sabbat" is lowercase, as the French style guide sets.

decisions.choice: "ngày Sa-bát"
decisions.reason: The style guide's form for the Sabbath, as in the Gospels.

source.text: וְלֹא־תוֹצִ֨יאוּ מַשָּׂ֤א מִבָּֽתֵּיכֶם֙ בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת וְכָל־מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַֽעֲשׂ֑וּ וְקִדַּשְׁתֶּם֙ אֶת־י֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And not you will bring out [a] burden from your houses on [the] day of the Sabbath, and any work not you will do; and you will keep holy [the] day of the Sabbath, as I commanded your fathers.

en.L: And do not bring a burden out of your houses on the day of the Sabbath, and do not do any work; but keep the day of the Sabbath holy, as I commanded your fathers.
en.B: Do not carry a load out of your houses on the Sabbath day, and do no work at all. Set the Sabbath day apart as holy, just as I commanded your ancestors.
en.R: Do not carry loads out of your houses on the Sabbath day or do any work. Instead, keep the Sabbath day holy, as I told your ancestors to do.

es.L: Ni {{plural_you:saquen|saquéis}} carga de {{plural_you:sus casas|vuestras casas}} en el día de reposo, ni {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} trabajo alguno; sino {{plural_you:santifiquen|santificad}} el día de reposo, como mandé a {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}}.
es.B: No {{plural_you:saquen|saquéis}} ninguna carga de {{plural_you:sus casas|vuestras casas}} en el día de reposo, ni {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} ningún trabajo. {{plural_you:Consagren|Consagrad}} el día de reposo, tal como mandé a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}.
es.R: No {{plural_you:saquen|saquéis}} cargas de {{plural_you:sus casas|vuestras casas}} en el día de reposo ni {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} ningún trabajo. Al contrario, {{plural_you:mantengan|mantened}} santo el día de reposo, como les dije a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} que hicieran.

fr.L: Et ne faites pas sortir de fardeau de vos maisons le jour du sabbat, et ne faites aucun travail ; mais sanctifiez le jour du sabbat, comme je l’ai ordonné à vos pères.
fr.B: Ne sortez pas de charge de vos maisons le jour du sabbat, et ne faites aucun travail. Mettez à part le jour du sabbat comme un jour saint, ainsi que je l’ai ordonné à vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}.
fr.R: Ne sortez pas de charges de vos maisons le jour du sabbat, et ne faites aucun travail. Au contraire, faites du sabbat un jour saint, comme je l’ai ordonné à vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}.

sw.L: Wala msitoe mzigo katika nyumba zenu siku ya Sabato, wala msifanye kazi yoyote; bali itakaseni siku ya Sabato, kama nilivyowaamuru baba zenu.
sw.B: Msitoe mzigo katika nyumba zenu siku ya Sabato, wala msifanye kazi yoyote. Itengeni siku ya Sabato iwe takatifu, kama nilivyowaamuru babu zenu.
sw.R: Msitoe mizigo katika nyumba zenu siku ya Sabato wala msifanye kazi yoyote. Badala yake, itunzeni siku ya Sabato iwe takatifu, kama nilivyowaagiza babu zenu.

vi.L: Cũng đừng mang gánh nặng ra khỏi nhà các ngươi vào ngày Sa-bát, và đừng làm việc gì cả; nhưng hãy giữ ngày Sa-bát làm ngày thánh, như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho tổ phụ các ngươi.

vi.R: Đừng mang đồ vật ra khỏi nhà vào ngày Sa-bát hay làm bất cứ việc gì. Trái lại, hãy giữ ngày Sa-bát làm ngày thánh, như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã bảo tổ tiên các ngươi.

ko.L: 안식일에 너희 집에서 짐을 내가지 말고 아무 일도 하지 마라. 내가 너희 조상들에게 명령한 대로 안식일을 거룩하게 지켜라.
ko.B: 안식일에는 너희 집에서 짐을 내가지 말고 아무 일도 하지 마라. 내가 너희 조상들에게 명령한 대로 안식일을 거룩하게 구별하여 지켜라.
ko.R: 안식일에는 너희 집에서 짐을 내가지 말고 아무 일도 하지 마라. 그 대신 내가 너희 조상들에게 하라고 한 대로 안식일을 거룩하게 지켜라.

pt.L: E não tirem carga das suas casas no dia do sábado, e não façam nenhum trabalho; mas santifiquem o dia do sábado, como ordenei aos pais de vocês.
pt.B: Não levem carga para fora das suas casas no dia de sábado, e não façam trabalho nenhum. Separem o dia de sábado como santo, assim como ordenei aos antepassados de vocês.
pt.R: Não levem cargas para fora das suas casas no dia de sábado nem façam trabalho nenhum. Pelo contrário, guardem o dia de sábado como dia santo, como mandei os antepassados de vocês fazerem.

decisions.choice: do no work; keep the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded your fathers: the words of the Ten Commandments
decisions.reason: The commandment says, "Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy" and "you shall not do any work" (Exodus 20:8, 10). Deuteronomy 5:12 adds "as the LORD your God commanded you", and the sermon echoes those words.

decisions.choice: keep holy: set apart for God
decisions.reason: To make the day holy is to treat it as belonging to God, different from the other days, by resting from ordinary work (Exodus 20:11; Genesis 2:3).

decisions.choice: fathers / ancestors
decisions.reason: As in 11:4: Literal keeps "fathers"; Balanced and Readable say "ancestors".

source.text: וְלֹ֣א שָֽׁמְע֔וּ וְלֹ֥א הִטּ֖וּ אֶת־אָזְנָ֑ם וַיַּקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־עָרְפָּ֔ם לְבִלְתִּ֣י שְׁמ֔וֹעַ וּלְבִלְתִּ֖י קַ֥חַת מוּסָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And not they listened, and not they inclined their ear, and they made stiff their neck, so as not to hear and not to receive discipline.

en.L: But they did not listen or incline their ear; they stiffened their neck so as not to hear and not to receive discipline.
en.B: But they did not listen or pay attention. They made their necks stiff so they would not hear or accept correction.
en.R: But your ancestors did not listen or pay attention. They were stubborn and refused to listen or to learn from correction.

es.L: Pero ellos no escucharon ni inclinaron su oído, sino que endurecieron su cerviz para no oír ni recibir corrección.
es.B: Pero ellos no escucharon ni prestaron atención. Endurecieron su cerviz para no oír ni aceptar la corrección.
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} no escucharon ni prestaron atención. Fueron tercos y se negaron a escuchar o a aprender de la corrección.

fr.L: Mais ils n’ont pas écouté, et ils n’ont pas tendu l’oreille ; ils ont raidi leur nuque pour ne pas écouter et ne pas recevoir la correction.
fr.B: Mais ils n’ont pas écouté ni prêté attention. Ils ont raidi la nuque pour ne pas entendre et ne pas accepter la leçon.
fr.R: Mais vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} n’ont pas écouté et n’ont pas fait attention. Ils ont été têtus et ont refusé d’écouter et de tirer la leçon de la correction.

sw.L: Lakini hawakusikiliza wala hawakutega sikio lao; walishupaza shingo yao ili wasisikie wala wasipokee marudi.
sw.B: Lakini hawakusikiliza wala hawakujali. Walishupaza shingo zao ili wasisikie wala wasikubali kurudiwa.
sw.R: Lakini babu zenu hawakusikiliza wala hawakujali. Walikuwa wakaidi, wakakataa kusikiliza wala kujifunza walipokaripiwa.

vi.L: Nhưng họ đã không nghe, cũng không nghiêng tai; họ đã cứng cổ, để không nghe và không nhận sự sửa dạy.
vi.B: Nhưng họ đã không nghe cũng không để ý. Họ cứng cổ để khỏi phải nghe hay nhận sự sửa dạy.
vi.R: Nhưng tổ tiên các ngươi đã không nghe hay để ý. Họ cứng đầu, không chịu nghe hay học hỏi khi bị sửa dạy.

ko.L: 그러나 그들은 듣지 않았고 귀를 기울이지도 않았다. 그들은 목을 곧게 하여 듣지도 않고 훈계를 받지도 않았다.
ko.B: 그러나 그들은 듣지도 귀 기울이지도 않았다. 그들은 목을 곧게 하여 듣지 않고 훈계를 받아들이지 않았다.
ko.R: 그러나 너희 조상들은 듣지도 귀 기울이지도 않았다. 그들은 고집을 부리며 듣지 않았고, 바로잡아 주어도 배우려 하지 않았다.

pt.L: Mas eles não ouviram, nem inclinaram o seu ouvido; endureceram a sua cerviz para não ouvir e para não receber disciplina.
pt.B: Mas eles não ouviram nem prestaram atenção. Endureceram o pescoço para não ouvir nem aceitar correção.
pt.R: Mas os antepassados de vocês não ouviram nem prestaram atenção. Foram teimosos e se recusaram a ouvir ou a aprender com a correção.

decisions.choice: they did not listen or incline their ear; they stiffened their neck: the book's charge against the generations before
decisions.reason: The same words come in 7:24, 26 and 11:8, and 7:28 also speaks of not accepting discipline. A stiff neck is the picture of an ox that will not bow to the yoke (Exodus 32:9; Deuteronomy 10:16).

decisions.choice: discipline: correction that teaches
decisions.reason: The word (musar) means training and correction, the kind a father gives a son (Proverbs 3:11), including the hard lessons of punishment (2:30; 5:3).

decisions.choice: to hear: the form read aloud (qere)
decisions.reason: The written consonants have another spelling of the same verb; the scribes marked the usual form to be read. The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: your ancestors / They were stubborn
decisions.reason: Readable names who "they" are and gives the sense of "stiffened their neck".

source.text: וְ֠הָיָה אִם־שָׁמֹ֨עַ תִּשְׁמְע֤וּן אֵלַי֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה לְבִלְתִּ֣י׀הָבִ֣יא מַשָּׂ֗א בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֛י הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֖את בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת וּלְקַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־י֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת לְבִלְתִּ֥י עֲשֽׂוֹת־בּ֖וֹ כָּל־מְלָאכָֽה׃

en.B: But if you truly listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and bring no load in through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, but keep the Sabbath day holy and do no work on it,
en.R: But listen carefully to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. If you bring no loads through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, if you keep the Sabbath day holy and do no work on it,

es.L: Y sucederá que, si de veras {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}}, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, para no meter carga por las puertas de esta ciudad en el día de reposo, sino santificar el día de reposo, sin hacer en él trabajo alguno,

Si no {{plural_you:meten|metéis}} cargas por las puertas de esta ciudad en el día de reposo, si {{plural_you:mantienen|mantenéis}} santo el día de reposo y no {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} en él ningún trabajo,

fr.L: Et il arrivera, si vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écoutez attentivement, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour ne pas faire entrer de fardeau par les portes de cette ville le jour du sabbat, et pour sanctifier le jour du sabbat en n’y faisant aucun travail,
fr.B: Mais si vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écoutez vraiment, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, si vous ne faites entrer aucune charge par les portes de cette ville le jour du sabbat, si vous gardez le jour du sabbat comme un jour saint sans y faire aucun travail,
fr.R: Mais écoutez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} bien, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Si vous ne faites passer aucune charge par les portes de cette ville le jour du sabbat, si vous faites du sabbat un jour saint et que vous n’y faites aucun travail,

sw.L: Na itakuwa, ikiwa mtanisikiliza kwa bidii, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, msiingize mzigo kwa malango ya mji huu siku ya Sabato, bali mkaitakase siku ya Sabato, msifanye kazi yoyote ndani yake,
sw.B: Lakini ikiwa mtanisikiliza kweli, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na msiingize mzigo kwa malango ya mji huu siku ya Sabato, bali mkaitakasa siku ya Sabato na kutofanya kazi yoyote ndani yake,
sw.R: Lakini nisikilizeni kwa makini, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Msipoingiza mizigo kwa malango ya mji huu siku ya Sabato, mkiitunza siku ya Sabato iwe takatifu na kutofanya kazi yoyote ndani yake,

vi.B: Nhưng nếu các ngươi thật sự lắng nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, không mang gánh nào vào qua các cổng thành này trong ngày Sa-bát, nhưng giữ ngày Sa-bát làm ngày thánh và không làm việc gì trong ngày ấy,
vi.R: Nhưng hãy lắng nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cho kỹ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Nếu các ngươi không mang đồ vật qua các cổng thành này vào ngày Sa-bát, nếu các ngươi giữ ngày Sa-bát làm ngày thánh và không làm việc gì trong ngày ấy,

pt.B: Mas, se vocês realmente {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ouvirem, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, e não fizerem entrar carga nenhuma pelas portas desta cidade no dia de sábado, mas santificarem o dia de sábado e não fizerem nele trabalho nenhum,
pt.R: Mas escutem-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} com atenção, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Se vocês não trouxerem cargas pelas portas desta cidade no dia de sábado, se guardarem o dia de sábado como dia santo e não fizerem nele trabalho nenhum,

decisions.choice: if you listen carefully: the verb is doubled for emphasis
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats the verb, "if listening you listen", meaning to listen in earnest and obey (Exodus 15:26; 19:5). Verses 24-26 promise what will follow if they do; verse 27 warns of what will follow if they do not.

decisions.choice: keep the Sabbath day holy: the test of whether the people will listen to God
decisions.reason: The Sabbath was a sign of the covenant between God and Israel (Exodus 31:13-17; Ezekiel 20:12). Keeping it, or breaking it, showed whether the people truly belonged to the LORD.

decisions.choice: But listen carefully to me ... If you
decisions.reason: Readable makes the call to listen a sentence of its own and then states the conditions, which continue into verse 25.

decisions.choice: the condition left open (않으면,) and closed in verse 25
alternatives: | Verses 24-25 are one conditional sentence; Korean leaves the condition open at the verse break so each verse keeps its own words, with "declares the LORD" kept where the Hebrew has it.

records.literal_gloss: and will enter by [the] gates of the city the this kings and princes sitting on [the] throne of David, riding in chariot[s] and on horses, they and their princes, [the] man of Judah and [the] inhabitants of Jerusalem; and will be inhabited the city the this forever.

en.L: then there will enter through the gates of this city kings and princes sitting on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they and their princes, {{gender:the people|the men}} of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city will be inhabited forever.
en.B: then kings and officials who sit on David's throne will come in through the gates of this city, riding in chariots and on horses, they and their officials, along with {{gender:the people|the men}} of Judah and those who live in Jerusalem. And this city will be lived in forever.
en.R: then kings who sit on David's throne will come through the gates of this city with their leaders. They will ride in chariots and on horses, together with the people of Judah and everyone who lives in Jerusalem. And people will live in this city forever.

es.R: entonces los reyes que se sientan en el trono de David entrarán por las puertas de esta ciudad con sus dirigentes. Irán montados en carros y en caballos, junto con la gente de Judá y todos los que viven en Jerusalén. Y habrá gente viviendo en esta ciudad para siempre.

fr.L: alors entreront par les portes de cette ville des rois et des princes assis sur le trône de David, montés sur des chars et des chevaux, eux et leurs princes, les {{gender:gens|hommes}} de Juda et les habitants de Jérusalem ; et cette ville sera habitée pour toujours.
fr.B: alors des rois et des chefs qui siègent sur le trône de David entreront par les portes de cette ville, montés sur des chars et des chevaux, eux et leurs chefs, avec les {{gender:gens|hommes}} de Juda et les habitants de Jérusalem. Et cette ville sera habitée pour toujours.
fr.R: alors des rois qui siègent sur le trône de David entreront par les portes de cette ville avec leurs chefs. Ils viendront en char et à cheval, avec les habitants de Juda et tous ceux qui vivent à Jérusalem. Et cette ville sera habitée pour toujours.

sw.L: ndipo wataingia kwa malango ya mji huu wafalme na wakuu wanaoketi katika kiti cha enzi cha Daudi, wakipanda magari na farasi, wao na wakuu wao, watu wa Yuda na wakaaji wa Yerusalemu; na mji huu utakaliwa milele.
